findings.summary: RED hashes candidate acceptance files but does not overlay those exact designed bytes into the immutable baseline worktree before executing a relative command.
Retained requirements re-entry does not re-verify every unchanged scenario, authority, dependency, acceptance, fixture, command, and control identity.
A design handoff can be recorded before the guarded test-design packet has an adapter-bound runtime identity.
The public CLI fixture uses moving current HEAD as baseline and would become green after its production adapter is committed.

requiredDisposition: Remediate all four as one batch, add regression tests that fail on the attempt-r1 behavior, rerun focused and aggregate validation, then perform fixed-baseline Standards and Spec re-review.
